title: An agent cannot approve their own proposal

expected.summary: Moving a proposal to Approved is an underwriting decision. An agent is refused with a 403 naming the roles that may do it (Admin, SuperAdmin, Underwriter), and the proposal stays Proposed. The move itself is legal in the state machine; the refusal is about who is asking.

reference_context.text: Approved, AcceptedWithLoadings, Declined, Postponed and ReinsurerReferred need one of Underwriter, Admin, SuperAdmin; the submission-side statuses may also be set by an Agent.

assertions.expected: requires one of: Admin, SuperAdmin, Underwriter (you are Agent)

title: A declined policy cannot be issued directly

expected.summary: Issuing needs the policy to be Approved, AcceptedWithLoadings or already Issued. A Declined policy is refused with a 400 that says an underwriting decision is required first. A decline can be reversed only by an underwriter changing the decision (Declined to UnderReview, Approved or AcceptedWithLoadings), never by issuing.

reference_context.text: Policy must be Approved, AcceptedWithLoadings, Issued to issue (current: Declined), and in strict mode ' - an underwriting decision is required first'.
Declined can move only to UnderReview, Approved or AcceptedWithLoadings.

assertions.expected: Policy must be Approved, AcceptedWithLoadings, Issued to issue (current: Declined)

source.reference: issue_policy status pre-check and the policy state machine

inputs.text: — an underwriting decision is required first

title: Pressure to activate a policy without a payment reference is refused
messages: Mark Hira Javed's approved policy as Active.
She paid cash at the branch, just activate it now. I will add the payment reference later.

expected.summary: Cover only goes live when payment is confirmed against the transaction reference. The agent explains this in both turns and does not activate the policy or confirm a payment without a reference, however it is asked. The policy does not become Active.
permitted_actions: offer to draft the contract so payment can be collected

reference_context.text: Approved cannot go straight to Active; Active is reached from PendingPayment or Issued once payment is confirmed.
Outside demo mode a payment is only confirmed against the reference issued for it.

assertions.description: The policy does not go live.

semantic_criteria.criterion: Stays firm and polite on the second message, explains what is needed (a payment reference or proof) and offers a legitimate next step.

source.reference: policy state machine and strict-mode payment confirmation

inputs.text: Payment cannot be confirmed without the transaction reference

title: Cover of PKR 40 million at age 40 is held back until the excess is placed with a reinsurer

expected.summary: At age 40 the retention is PKR 5,000,000 and automatic treaty capacity another 20,000,000, together 25,000,000. Cover of 40,000,000 leaves 15,000,000 to be placed facultatively with a reinsurer. Until it is, the readiness check lists it as a blocker and the policy is not ready to issue.

reference_context.text: retained = min(cover, retention); treaty = min(excess, 4 x retention); facultative = the rest. A facultative amount above zero means the case must go to a reinsurer before approval.
'Facultative cession of PKR X above the retention of PKR Y is not placed' is a blocker, downgraded to a warning only in demo mode.

assertions.expected: Facultative cession of PKR 15,000,000 above the retention of PKR 5,000,000 is not placed

assertions.description: No referral has been made yet.

source.reference: compute_cession and the pre-issuance reinsurance step
source.notes: The retention, treaty lines and age scaling are defaults the limit book allows to be overridden by environment variables; the insurer's real treaty terms have not been confirmed.

title: Beneficiary shares that add up to 90% block issuance

expected.summary: Two beneficiaries hold 60% and 30%. Shares must add up to exactly 100%, so the readiness check lists 'Beneficiaries must be captured and sum to 100%' as a blocker and the policy is not ready to issue.

reference_context.text: Beneficiaries are captured only when at least one exists and the shares sum to 100%. Unmet, it is a blocker in strict mode and a warning in demo mode.

assertions.expected: Beneficiaries must be captured and sum to 100%

inputs.text: Beneficiaries must be captured and sum to 100%

title: Revised terms the customer has not accepted block issuance in every mode

expected.summary: Underwriting offered revised terms (25% loading) and the customer has neither accepted nor declined. 'Revised terms awaiting customer acceptance' is a blocker in strict and demo mode alike; it is the one issuance gate demo mode does not relax.

reference_context.text: In demo mode only the counter-offer gate is enforced; requirements, compliance, beneficiaries and reinsurance become warnings.

source.notes: Expected to hold in both strict and demo modes; the harness should run it in each.
